title: Generation manifest (version 3)
description: The manifest written last inside state/generations/<generationHash>/manifest.json. The directory name and the state/current target basename are the generationHash. Layers are immutable content-addressed entries referenced by relative generation-local paths; appearance is the one composed token document plus one CSS sheet per target config dir. An optional host block records only the delegated host values that participated, and intent.host must equal its fingerprint. A consumer rejects a manifest whose generationHash, layer hashes, relative paths, mode or appearance targets do not validate. Manifest values are opaque hashes and identities only: no literal colours, no structure and no variants.

generationHash.description: Canonical generation identity; must equal the generation directory basename and the state/current target basename.

mode.description: The palette mode selected at generation. Mode is a generation input and part of generation identity.

configDir.description: Exactly one lowercase app config-directory segment.

identifier.description: A non-colour provenance token. '#' is deliberately not accepted: the manifest carries no literal hex.

at.description: When the complete generation directory was written in staging.

by.description: Optional producer identity, for example the runtime release.

at.description: When state/current was atomically swapped to this generation.

jobId.description: Optional daemon converge job id that committed the generation.

entryHash.description: Content hash of the immutable cache entry this generation reuses.

path.description: Generation-local relative path to the layer link/entry.

mode.description: The skin resolution mode; it must equal the manifest's top-level mode.

configDir.description: The app config-directory name; the platform carries no app list beyond this manifest.

path.description: The composed generation-local sheet for this config dir.

tokensPath.description: The mode-resolved v2 token document inside this generation.

targets.description: One composed sheet per app config dir. Config dirs are unique; the generation is the only app-list input.

source.description: Host source for Phase 1. Other compositor sources require a later contract enum addition.

version.description: Host mapping version; 1 is hyprland.paint.v1. A mapping change bumps this value and therefore hostHash.

fingerprint.description: hostHash over the mapping version and only the values that actually participated. It excludes the instance signature, timestamps and set flags.

surface.panel.radius.description: Resolved host value for the delegated panel radius.

surface.panel.border-width.description: Resolved host value for the delegated panel border width.

defaults.description: Only the delegated host values that participated in this generation, keyed by logical appearance token path. Omit the whole host block when no value participated.

host.description: Optional resolved host snapshot. Present only when at least one delegated token used the host. intent.host must equal fingerprint; JSON Schema cannot express that equality, so runtime validation enforces it.
Must equal host.fingerprint when the host block is present. Present only for a host-participating generation.

kind.description: Which executor ran the one converge pipeline: the daemon job queue or the CLI flock fallback.

intentHash.description: Hash of the desired.json intent snapshot used for this convergence.

jobId.description: Daemon job id; absent for the CLI fallback.

relativePath.description: A generation-local relative path: no leading slash, no empty segment, no '.' or '..' segment and no '#'.
